images.action_name: 扶稳双脚提踵功能观察
images.target_pose: 双脚平行站稳，两侧脚跟与前足均接地，一手轻扶固定扶手。
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE independent photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photograph, portrait 1122 x 1402, no collage.
The three input images are strictly IDENTITY / CLOTHING / STYLE / BACKGROUND references: preserve the exact same adult East Asian woman, black low ponytail, natural friendly face, white plain short-sleeve T-shirt and dark charcoal fitted long trousers, normal adult proportions. Preserve their softly lit plain cool gray-blue studio background and floor, photographic realism.
Requested frame: action 025 E-LOW-011, step 01, supported bilateral heel raise START position. Full body from head to complete shoes, side view facing right with a slight front-side angle so both feet and their separate ground contacts are visible. She stands naturally upright, spine neutral and BOTH knees comfortably extended without forceful locking. BOTH feet parallel hip-width apart on flat floor, both white plain low-profile trainers FULLY FLAT: both heels and both forefeet touching ground. Both shoes complete and separated visibly. One hand rests LIGHTLY on a stable fixed matte-gray rehabilitation handrail in front/right, the other arm hangs naturally. The handrail has a horizontal rail at waist height and vertical metal posts visibly fixed to the floor with circular bolt plates. Only one woman and the minimal fixed handrail.
Composition: woman slightly left of center, enough empty space above and floor margin below both shoes, whole head and both hands visible. Neutral studio eye-level 70mm-looking full-body photograph; prevent wide-angle limb distortion. Feet are parallel with NO forward step, NO heel rise yet. This is the baseline before tiptoe raising.
Avoid: chair, walker, change of identity, extra limbs or fingers, altered white T-shirt or trousers, stretched torso/short legs/long arms, toe walking, jumping, one foot off floor, text, arrows, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, inset, diptych.

visual_review.identity_background: 与3张原始身份风格参考核对通过：同一东亚女性、低马尾、白T深灰裤、灰蓝棚拍背景；同组白鞋一致。
visual_review.anatomy_proportions: 逐张view_image审查，两臂两腿、正常人体比例，完整头部双手与双鞋入镜。
visual_review.support_equipment: 一手轻扶灰色固定横扶手，立柱底部圆形螺栓板可见；鞋底和地面接触关系符合该步骤。
visual_review.pose_result: 双脚平行站稳，两侧脚跟与前足均接地，一手轻扶固定扶手。

BOTH shoes tilt down toward their forefoot contact, a visible floor gap under BOTH heel soles. Show the woman's body elevated naturally by ankle plantarflexion; head/torso moves slightly up, spine vertical, both knees retain comfortable extension. Two parallel feet, BOTH heels off ground, not one leg balancing. Slight front-side view from baseline makes two white shoe heel gaps readable separately. No whole foot floating.
Keep normal adult body proportions, natural arms and two anatomically correct legs, all head/hands/shoes fully within frame with floor margin. No extra objects, no text, no arrows, no collage. Avoid: one heel flat, one raised foot, jumping, bent-knee squat, forward stepping, increased rail height, equipment shifting, camera change, background hue drift, changed shoes or person, distorted joints.
